---
title: "Software & Data"
---

Documented model frameworks that accompany published papers. Each repository states the model with the paper's equation numbers, describes the data pipeline and the input formats, and includes a runnable implementation with examples on synthetic data and tests.

| Framework | Accompanies | Repository |
|---|---|---|
| Two-stage stochastic planning of electrolyzers, hydrogen storage and fuel cells with inter-zonal hydrogen transport | International Journal of Hydrogen Energy (2025) | [txh2-ercot-hydrogen](https://github.com/Henryutd2021/txh2-ercot-hydrogen) |
| Demand-side load regulation guided by real-time emission intensity | Cell Reports Sustainability (2025) | [ghg-load-regulation](https://github.com/Henryutd2021/ghg-load-regulation) |
| Supply-chain facility location with on-site microgrids; virtual power plant scheduling | Applied Mathematical Modelling (2023); IEEE SEGRE 2023; M.S. thesis (2021) | [supply-chain-microgrid-models](https://github.com/Henryutd2021/supply-chain-microgrid-models) |
| Multi-fidelity Gaussian process regression for probabilistic wind power curves | ASME IDETC 2023 | [mfgpr-wind-power-curve](https://github.com/Henryutd2021/mfgpr-wind-power-curve) |
| Cost of delayed energization for AI data centers: private, ratepayer and social accounts | IEEE NAPS 2026 (accepted) | [code-delayed-energization](https://github.com/Henryutd2021/code-delayed-energization) |

For the data and code of individual studies, see each paper's data availability statement.
